title: Allwinner H3 DDR3 x16 reference design: DDR3-FBGA96 DU1 to Allwinner-H3 U1
description: A spacious multilayer benchmark routing a balanced 16-net subset of 53 exact DDR3-to-BGA endpoint pairs from Allwinner H3 DDR3 x16 reference design.

referenceDesign.board: Allwinner H3 DDR3 x16 reference design
referenceDesign.extractionMethod: Exact KiCad PCB pad/net traversal; a single two-pad series resistor may be collapsed into one benchmark connection and is recorded per path.

placement.componentGapDefinition: minimum horizontal clearance between the physical pad-field edges

feasibility.focus: fan out both real BGA footprints, then route a representative subset of exact reference DDR3 endpoint pairs
feasibility.viaStyle: 0.273 mm dogbone-compatible via pad; via-in-pad disabled
